description: Election Commission - Two members of the Nuwaraeliya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their of member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that two members of the Nuwaraeliya Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their political party (Ceylon Workers Congress). This is a direct notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance concerning the status of elected members of a local government body, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
